[SWS_CM_10429] Identifying the right application error in a message with Mes- sage Type set to ERROR (0x81)
⌈
If the Return Code see [PRS_SOMEIP_00040])
contains a value equal to 0x01 (E_NOT_OK) then the corresponding ApApplica-
tionError shall be identfied by deserializing the Payload of the message according
to the error payload format described in [SWS_CM_10428].
